description: Find anything this server can answer, and the operations that act on it. Searches components, conventions, engineering constraints, AI instruction sets, releases, the Rust crates, the agent skills, the toolchain (the CLI, how to install anything, this server) and, when docs.mzizi.dev answers, the documentation. Returns `results` (hits, paged), `docs` (documentation matches), and `operations`: each with its `arguments` (JSON Schema), the `permission` it needs (free, or sign-in) and `mayRun`, whether you may run it now. Run one with mzizi_execute {operation, arguments}. `allOperations` lists every operation. A component hit with `rustCrate` has a Mzizi Roots (Rust) implementation, which is the lead; at an equal score it ranks first. Paged: up to 50 hits per call and at most 25000 characters; results.meta.has_more and results.meta.next_offset say how to get the rest.

offset.description: Hits to skip, for paging. Use results.meta.next_offset from the previous call.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'button', 'install', 'cli', 'contrast', 'crates' or an operation name. Every word must match.

name: mzizi_search
title: Search Mzizi
